title: Genesis GV90: A New Luxury Electric SUV with Innovative Features
summary: Genesis has launched the GV90, its new flagship electric SUV, based on the Neolum concept. The GV90 features a sleek design, advanced safety features like the world's first roof airbag, and high-end technology including a retractable 3.5-inch OLED 'Cinematic Display' and a 25-speaker 3D sound system. It uses Hyundai's 800V E-GMP platform, enabling fast charging (10-80% in 22 minutes) and offers a range of up to 310 miles. The GV90 comes in four-seat and seven-seat configurations, with the high-end GV90 Neolum variant featuring pillarless coach doors and premium interior materials.
key_points: Genesis GV90 is a new luxury electric SUV based on the Neolum concept, now in production.
Features include a four-seat and seven-seat configuration, with the high-end GV90 Neolum offering pillarless coach doors (Neolum Arch Gate).
World’s first roof airbag included, along with 11 other airbags for enhanced safety.
Retractable 3.5-inch OLED 'Cinematic Display' that expands when parked, paired with a 25-speaker Bang & Olufsen 3D sound system.
Uses Hyundai’s 800V E-GMP platform, supporting fast charging (10-80% in 22 minutes) and a range of up to 310 miles.
Dual motor setup delivers 657 hp (490 kW) and 590 lb-ft (800 Nm) of torque, split between front and rear axles.
No official details yet on U.S. release date or pricing.
